name: Guadeloupe
peoples: Kalinago communities and earlier Indigenous societies
summary: So valuable that Britain traded it back—and later assigned its title to Sweden.
notes: Basse-Terre and Grande-Terre form the principal track. In 1794 republican reconquest unfolded over months. Sweden received a title in 1813, but Britain continued to administer the colony.

events.title: A Spanish claim to Karukera
events.detail: Columbus’s second voyage reached an island inhabited by Kalinago communities.
events.qualification: A European claim; it does not establish island-wide administration or extinguish Indigenous rights.

events.title: French colonization begins
events.detail: A chartered company expedition established a colony; warfare and dispossession followed.

events.title: Britain captures Guadeloupe
events.detail: The Seven Years’ War brought British occupation of the sugar colony.

events.title: Returned under the Treaty of Paris
events.detail: France recovered Guadeloupe as part of the global peace settlement.

events.title: British invasion
events.detail: British forces occupied the colony during war with revolutionary France.

events.title: Republican forces expel Britain
events.detail: Victor Hugues’s campaign, supported by newly freed Black soldiers, completed the reconquest.
events.uncertainty: French reconquest began in June; December marks the end of British occupation rather than Hugues’s arrival.

events.title: Resistance to restored slavery
events.detail: French troops crushed resistance to the reimposition of slavery. Sovereignty did not change.

events.title: Britain takes the colony again
events.detail: The Napoleonic Wars brought renewed British occupation.

events.title: A Swedish title, British administration
events.detail: Britain granted Guadeloupe to the Swedish crown as part of an anti-Napoleonic alliance; Sweden never administered it.

events.title: Swedish title relinquished
events.detail: The Treaty of Paris restored French sovereignty; British administration continued until handover.

events.title: French administration resumes
events.detail: The treaty was implemented on the island.

events.title: One last British occupation
events.detail: Napoleon’s Hundred Days triggered a final British expedition.

events.title: The final handover to France
events.uncertainty: Published accounts disagree on the precise July handover day.

events.title: An overseas department
events.detail: Guadeloupe became a department of France; it did not become independent.
